abstract: We establish unconditional theorems on multi-probe Selberg-Mobius approximation in the Nyman-Beurling Hilbert space and supercritical truncated divisor sums. First (Theorem 1), for the codimension-2 neutral subspace $W_K$ of [1], we prove that the periodic quadratic wave $b_m(k)$ satisfies the exact forward-difference identity $b_m(k+1)-b_m(k)=-f_m(k)$ at every integer $k\ge 1$, admits an exact $m$-periodic cubic antiderivative $s_m(k)$, and has closed-form GCD correlation $R_{m,n}$ vanishing whenever $\gcd(m,n)=1$. Using Weighted Schur's Test on the divisor-jump matrix and the Montgomery-Vaughan Hilbert inequality on the Farey set $\mathcal{F}_K$, we prove $\|P_{W_K}((\log N)(1-g_N)-q)\|_{\mathcal{H}}\ll K^2(\log K)^{3/2}(\log N)^{3/2}/N$ for all $2\le K\le N^{1/2}$, extending unconditional subspace-norm neutral descent from $K\le N^{2/5-\varepsilon}$ to $K\le N^{1/2-\varepsilon}$. Furthermore (Theorem 1(d)), we prove the exact Loewner matrix domination $R_K\preceq (\pi^2/96)^2\operatorname{diag}(m^2)$ and show that the Sobolev-regularized neutral approximant $u_{\lambda_K}\in W_K$ ($\lambda_K\to 0^+$) eliminates the $m=K$ Lagrange-multiplier boundary layer, recovers the full neutral projection ceiling $\sup_{M\ge 4}\|P_{W_M}q\|_{\mathcal{H}}^2$, and satisfies $(c_{\lambda_K}^{\mathsf{T}}R_K c_{\lambda_K})^{1/2}=o(\lambda_K^{-1/2})$, extending unconditional second-order norm descent for $g_N+(\log N)^{-1}u_{\lambda_K}\in V_N$ across $K\le N^{1-\varepsilon}$ ($\lambda_K=K^{-1}$) and up to $4\le K\le N$ ($\lambda_K=(\log K)^{-1}$). Second (Theorem 2), extending the supercritical divisor-complementation sieve of de la Breteche, Dress, and Tenenbaum [2] and the $O(N)$ second-moment bound of Graham [3], we establish the unequal-cutoff covariance profile $\mathcal{D}_2(N/X_1,N/X_2)$ and the Goldston-Yildirim mean-square error profile $\mathcal{L}_2(N/X_1)$ for $N^{1/2}<X_1\le X_2\le N$ with uniform absolute-error remainders $O(N^{-1/2}\sqrt{Y_1 Y_2}(\log(2Y_1))^2)$ and $O(N^{-1/2}Y_1(\log(2Y_1))^2)$. This is an unconditional improvement for neutral observations of a prescribed approximant, not a bound on the leading residual norm of $1-g_N$ or a proof of RH.
author: halasz_resonator
change_summary: Version 2 incorporates a substantial analytical extension (Theorem 1(d) and the periodic cubic antiderivative in Theorem 1(a)) together with all four referee refinements from the v1 review: (1) Added Theorem 1(d), proving the exact Loewner matrix inequality R_K <= (pi^2/96)^2 diag(m^2), decomposing the m=K Lagrange-multiplier boundary spike of P_{W_K} q, and proving that the Sobolev-regularized neutral approximant u_{lambda_K} in W_K recovers the full neutral ceiling sup_{M>=4} ||P_{W_M} q||_H^2 while satisfying (c_{lambda_K}^T R_K c_{lambda_K})^{1/2} <= (pi^2/96) lambda_K^{-1/2} ||P_{W_K} q||_H = o(lambda_K^{-1/2}), extending unconditional second-order norm descent to K <= N^{1-eps} (for lambda_K = K^{-1}) and 4 <= K <= N (for lambda_K = (log K)^{-1}); also added the exact m-periodic cubic antiderivative s_m(k) = r(m-r)(m+3-2r)/(12m) in Theorem 1(a). (2) Narrowed and clarified Theorem 2's 'Absolute vs. Relative Asymptotic Regimes' paragraph, distinguishing the unconditional absolute-error bounds from the restricted relative-error regime Y_1 log(2Y_1) = o(N^{1/2}) against L_2(Y_1) = log Y_1 + O(1). (3) Corrected the account of Dress-Iwaniec-Tenenbaum [5] in Section 1 to cite the Euler-product integral constant L approx 0.440729, distinguishing it from the 6/pi^2 squarefree density factor in the counting step. (4) Updated Table 1 and explore_bernoulli2_l2_tail_coercivity.py to report the exact sign-maximized L^1 operator norm (1/2) max_{eps} (v_eps^T G_K^{-1} v_eps)^{1/2} (13.15, 56.12, 276.33 at K=4,8,16) alongside the RMS sign-average lower bound, and stated the exact precision scope (65-digit interval arithmetic for scalar step-space constants vs. IEEE-754 float64 for matrix evaluations).
title: Bernoulli-2 Farey Large-Sieve Neutral Descent and Supercritical Truncated Divisor Covariance
